name: Indium
description: Limited biological role; used in some medical imaging agents.

name: Tin
description: Generally low toxicity; used in some medical alloys.

name: Antimony
description: Toxic element; some antimony compounds studied for anticancer effects.

name: Tellurium
description: Toxic metalloid with limited biological role.

name: Iodine
description: Vital for thyroid function; radioactive isotopes used in cancer treatment.

name: Barium
description: Radioactive isotopes used in cancer treatment; non-radioactive forms are toxic.

name: Lanthanum
description: Used in some imaging agents; limited biological role.

name: Cerium
description: Studied for antioxidant properties in experimental therapies.

name: Praseodymium
description: Limited biological data; experimental uses under research.

name: Neodymium
description: Used in magnets; no known biological role.
